hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_response.filePath // .tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; case "$f" in ""|null) exit 0;; esac; if [ -x ./node_modules/.bin/prettier ]; then ./node_modules/.bin/prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; else npx prettier --write --ignore-unknown "$f"; fi; } 2>/dev/null || true
